title: Vigilator
excerpt: The human-in-the-loop layer for AI agents.
content_html:
The human-in-the-loop layer for AI agents.

One platform, every agent under supervision

Vigilator lets your agents take on high-stakes work, shows you they are doing what you expect,
and hands over to a human the moment it matters most. Integrate into any system.

Interrupts, in one place

Every request an agent cannot decide alone or must have approved, with the full conversation and the exact tool calls it wants to run. Approve, edit the arguments, or reject with a reason.

See every agent, live

Connected agents report what they are doing in realtime. Spot one going rogue and step in before it becomes a liability.

Classified, then sent to the right team

Tag interrupts and sessions by type and route them to the people who own that decision.

Nothing sits unanswered

Set your own rules for when a request is raised to an escalated queue - by wait time, classification or team - so nothing slips through the gaps.

A first pass on every request

Argus optionally summarises and classifies the interrupt, flags anything risky and drafts a suggested decision, so reviewers decide in moments.

Know how your team performs

Approval rates, response times and volume per team and per agent is all logged.

Notifications, escalation & webhooks

Get notified the moment a request needs you - by email or in-app - and approve or reject from there. If nobody responds, escalation chains hand it to the next reviewer. Push decisions and events into your own infrastructure with webhooks.

Every action, on the record

A searchable audit log of the whole organisation: who approved, rejected, escalated or reassigned what, who changed a role, created a key or edited a webhook - and what your agents did through the API. Filter by person, category and time, open the detail behind any entry, and export to CSV. A Pro feature.

Roles & teams

Decide who can view, decide and escalate. Organisations are fully isolated and permissions can be fine-grained.

Security Based

Secure by design & security at the core of our work.

Plain HTTP, any framework

OpenAPI spec and an interactive reference. If your agent can make a request, it can raise an interrupt.
